name: elbow tendinopathy overview
title: Pain around the elbow from a muscle or tendon: where the pain sits and whether the tendon ruptured decide the diagnosis; lateral and medial epicondylosis and distal biceps tendinopathy are treated as tendinosis, a distal biceps rupture goes urgently to orthopaedics

root.title: Elbow pain from a MUSCLE or TENDON: WHERE is it, and did it RUPTURE?
lines: ACUTE (traumatic, inflammatory) or CHRONIC (degenerative, overuse)? · overlay the anatomy: which structure sits where the pain is?
Muscle and tendon problems affect elbow PAIN and STRENGTH · see the ELBOW chart for joint, ligament and bursa causes

groups.title: TENDINOPATHY: insidious onset
lines: pain on RESISTED movement + pain on passive STRETCH

groups.title: RUPTURE
lines: trauma, or the end of long overuse

head: h
Lateral epicondylosis
'tennis elbow'
mostly extensor carpi radialis brevis
pres: Pain just DISTAL to the lateral epicondyle
• pain AND weakness, worst gripping + supinating
inv: • tender over the common extensor tendon
• resisted MIDDLE finger extension ± wrist extension ± supination hurts

head: h
Medial epicondylosis
'golfer's elbow'
common flexor origin
pres: Pain at the common flexor origin

head: h
Distal biceps RUPTURE
rare but consequential
tx: repair has a limited time window

rows: Tendinitis or tendinosis? It changes the treatment
true inflammation from rheumatologic disease, acute overload or infection
collagen degeneration from chronic overuse, NO inflammation · slow: 100+ days to make collagen
1 · Educate: what it is, what to expect, change the offending activity
2 · Relative rest (by time or task) · ergonomics · ice · orthoses or taping (lateral: counterforce strap during the offending activity)
3 · Physiotherapy: ECCENTRIC strengthening twice daily × 12 weeks · massage
4 · Anti-inflammatories (topical preferred) help less in tendinOSIS
5 · Platelet-rich plasma (PRP)? · surgical referral if refractory
